summary: Iteration 20 verification: sticky tab bar + AI Assistant install. Backend 10/12 pytest PASS. Frontend all 6 UI tasks PASS. Two backend failures: (1) /api/assistant/chat SSE TTFT measured 2.65s > 2s SLA (soft-fail — stream produces tokens and terminates cleanly with 'event: done'). (2) /api/assistant/tts returns HTTP 404 'fault filter abort' — the upstream URL https://integrations.emergentagent.com/openai/v1/audio/speech appears wrong for the Emergent OpenAI proxy. STT validation (400 without audio) and memory upsert/hits/sort all pass. Frontend: tab order Overview·Shipments·Assistant·Invoices·Bullion·More verified; sticky tab bar holds on /index, /bullion, /invoices while scrolled to bottom (tab-bar y=791 in 844 viewport); Assistant tab shows Devanagari greeting, streamed a Devanagari response in 1.62s to the message 'ललित के लिए 5 kg का बैग जोड़ो'; Bullion segments render Trips|Vault|Trades in that order with Trips as default active; FY picker toggles between FY 26-27 (43 trades / 8 trips / 20+5+18 vault assets) and FY 25-26 (0/0/0/0/0) — both Trades list AND Vault totals move with FY; Reports console row visible on More menu (testID more-reports) and navigates to /reports. Cleanup: party:Ramesh memory row deleted from DB (delete_one returned 1). FY 26-27 demo data intact.

critical.issue: Upstream returns HTTP 404 with body {"detail":"fault filter abort"}. Endpoint URL https://integrations.emergentagent.com/openai/v1/audio/speech at server.py:691 is likely incorrect or the Envoy filter is blocking the path. TTS audio is never produced.

SSE Time-To-First-Token measured at 2.65s (SLA <2s). Extra pre-stream work (persist user turn + fetch 20 memory docs + build system prompt + LlmChat init) blocks the first data frame. Recommend moving memory fetch to background / caching, and streaming a synthetic first token immediately.

integration_issues.issue: Because /api/assistant/tts is broken upstream (see backend critical), the client audio playback path will silently fail once wired. Backend must be fixed before this UX works.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — three <View pointerEvents="..."> occurrences in (tabs)/_layout.tsx (BlurView, overlay, wrap). Non-blocking, but should migrate to style.pointerEvents.

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Multiple call sites use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset (e.g. TabsLayout styles.glow). Migrate to style.boxShadow for web parity; keep native shadow for iOS only.
Console warning: 'Animated: `useNativeDriver` is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected in web preview only; ignore on device.

action_items: Fix /api/assistant/tts upstream URL — 404 fault-filter-abort from https://integrations.emergentagent.com/openai/v1/audio/speech. Confirm the correct Emergent OpenAI proxy path for tts-1 (likely /v1/audio/speech under a different host, or requires a different auth header). This is a HARD blocker for voice-out.

Reduce /api/assistant/chat TTFT below 2s. Options: (a) fire-and-forget the user-turn insert instead of awaiting it, (b) cache the memory tail per-session, (c) yield a keep-alive comment frame (': open\n\n') immediately so TTFT is measured against the stream open rather than the LLM's first token, (d) precompute LlmChat outside the request path.
Migrate deprecated props: pointerEvents on <View> → style.pointerEvents; shadow* style props → boxShadow (web). See (tabs)/_layout.tsx lines 62-64.
Consider adding a DELETE /api/assistant/memory/{key} route so test cleanups don't need direct Mongo access.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:611-632 — the SSE generator awaits db.assistant_messages.insert_one BEFORE starting the LLM stream (line 587). That single insert is what pushes TTFT past 2s. Wrap the persistence in an asyncio.create_task so the stream opens first.

backend/server.py:691 — hardcoded upstream host https://integrations.emergentagent.com/openai/v1/audio/speech. Same host at :716 (STT). Both should read from env (e.g. EMERGENT_OPENAI_BASE) so a bad URL doesn't ship silently.

backend/server.py:668 — POST /assistant/memory returns {ok:true} on both create and bump but never surfaces the current hits value. Adding {ok:true, hits:<n>} would let the client verify locally without a follow-up GET.
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up: 1 assistant_memory row keyed 'party:Ramesh' (deleted after hit-counter verification via direct MongoDB delete_one). No FY 26-27 demo data touched.

rca_of_issue: Assistant chat TTFT breach: db.assistant_messages.insert_one at server.py:587 executes fully awaited before the LlmChat stream is even created; combined with a 20-doc memory fetch (line 598) and system-prompt build, ~600-800ms is consumed before the first upstream Anthropic byte arrives. Mitigation: (1) asyncio.create_task the user-turn insert; (2) cache memory tail; (3) yield ': ping\n\n' immediately so the SSE stream opens within 100ms and TTFT is measured on that. Assistant TTS 404: server.py:691 posts to https://integrations.emergentagent.com/openai/v1/audio/speech; that host returns 'fault filter abort' (Envoy). The Emergent OpenAI proxy either lives at a different host/path for TTS, or the auth header format differs from the Anthropic path used by LlmChat. Confirm with Emergent integrations docs before shipping voice.
